info.title: Mnemom API
info.description: Trust infrastructure for AI agents. Transparent alignment verification, behavioral drift detection, and accountability primitives.

tags.name: A2A
tags.description: Public A2A AgentCard projection of the canonical alignment card, with embedded AAP attestation extension (cards-as-primitive Phase 5).

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Agent registration, lifecycle, and metadata.

tags.name: Agent Containment
tags.description: Containment policies and quarantine controls.

tags.name: Agent Groups
tags.description: Lightweight logical tags for bucketing an org's agents — the unscored counterpart to the scored Teams primitive. No cards, coherence, reputation, or feature gate.

tags.name: Alignment
tags.description: Alignment manifest CRUD — canonical `/v1/alignment/<scope>/<scope_id>` surface across platform / org / team / agent (cards-as-primitive Phase 4).

tags.name: Analyze

tags.name: Aletheia Support
tags.description: In-product Aletheia assistant MVP (issue #2195) — chat + voice adapters over one shared answer core. Gated behind ALETHEIA_SUPPORT_MVP_ENABLED + the ALETHEIA_SUPPORT_ALLOWLIST identity allowlist (whose default is the whole @mnemom.ai domain, and which may be set to "*" to admit every authenticated identity), fail-closed 404 for every non-allowed caller. Dark by default; whether it is customer-facing depends on that env var per deployment.

tags.name: Attestation
tags.description: AAP attestation token JWKS surface and platform-admin signing-key rotation (cards-as-primitive Phase 5).

tags.name: Consent

tags.name: Invite Message Template

tags.name: Code
tags.description: Mnemom Agent — the governed agent launcher (`mnemom agent`). The per-org feature gate the CLI checks at startup; invites and access reuse the product-invite surface with product `code`.

tags.name: Invites

tags.name: Coherence
tags.description: Coherence report-claim round-trip (MNE-1379): single-use claim-intent tickets that carry a report claim across the sign-up/email-confirm/return round-trip so no session token rides the URL — only the opaque `mci_…` ticket.

BearerAuth.description: Supabase JWT token in Authorization: Bearer header

ServiceRole.description: Supabase service role bearer JWT. Used by /blog admin operations that talk directly to Supabase. NOT used by /internal/* or /v1/arena/internal/* — those use the custom-header schemes below.

InternalKeyAuth.name: X-Internal-Key
InternalKeyAuth.description: Internal service-to-service shared secret, timing-safe compared against INTERNAL_API_KEY. Used by /internal/* gateway routes (compose, agents, webhooks emit).

ServiceKeyAuth.name: X-Service-Key
ServiceKeyAuth.description: Service-to-service shared secret, timing-safe compared against MNEMOM_SERVICE_KEY. Used by /v1/arena/internal/*, /v1/on-chain/*, and the /v1/internal/* readers consumed by the reputation cron.

CoherenceTokenAuth.description: Per-cell coherence bearer token. Provisioned in 1Password vault `mnemom-coherence` (one item per receiver). Value compared against COHERENCE_<NAME>_SERVICE_TOKEN_EXPECTED. Used by /v1/internal/coherence/* and /v1/internal/governance/dispatch.

ArenaCandidateTokenAuth.description: Dedicated arena writer token (ADR-004 §"Arena dedicated writer token"). Compared against ARENA_RECIPE_CANDIDATE_TOKEN. The token's only capability is writing recipe candidates with writer_identity='arena-bypass' (stamped server-side). Used by POST /v1/internal/recipe-candidates.

CustomerVoiceTokenAuth.description: Customer Voice API bearer token. Timing-safe compared against CUSTOMER_VOICE_API_TOKEN. Grants access to all /v1/internal/feedback/* endpoints (MNE-1876). No customer-facing or reporter-read capability.

CookieAuth.name: mnemom_session
CookieAuth.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookie issued by /v1/auth/sign-in (or the SSO / email-callback flows). The value is an AES-256-GCM-encrypted blob of {access_token, refresh_token, issued_at, auth_method}. Browser clients include this automatically with `credentials: "include"`.

LicenseJwtAuth.description: License JWT (HS256, HMAC-signed with LICENSE_SIGNING_SECRET). Used by self-hosted deployment instances to authenticate `/v1/deployments/heartbeat`. Not interchangeable with the Supabase user JWT.

AgentAuth.name: X-Mnemom-Agent-Proof
AgentAuth.description: Agent possession proof: the full SHA-256 hex digest of `${apiKey}|${agentName}` (or `${apiKey}` for an unnamed singleton agent) — the same `hash_proof` primitive used by POST /v1/agents claim, link-agent, and verify-binding. The server resolves the agent by `agent_hash = proof[:16]`. The agent's *own* identity (ADR-API-001 third auth class) — distinct from ApiKeyAuth (`X-Mnemom-Api-Key`, which resolves a user/account, not an agent).

SubmissionId.name: submission_id
SubmissionId.description: Aletheia Customer Voice feedback submission identifier (UUID).

PaymentRequired.description: Paid feature gate — the caller's plan doesn't include this operation's feature flag. Emitted by `requireFeature` / `requireEntitlement` in `src/org/rbac.ts`.

InternalServerError.description: Server error — request was well-formed but the server failed to fulfill it. Typically a downstream dependency (DB / RPC / external API) returned an unexpected error.

Conflict.description: Resource conflict — the request cannot proceed because of a current state conflict (e.g., resource already exists, version mismatch, in-flight idempotency key with a different body).

UnprocessableEntity.description: Request was well-formed but semantically invalid (e.g., business-rule validation failure, malformed YAML inside a JSON payload).

Gone.description: The target is no longer available — a single-use, time-boxed resource (e.g. a claim-intent ticket) that has been consumed or has expired.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate-limit exceeded. The global per-IP limiter (100 requests/minute, applied to every `/v1/*` route) rejected this request. Back off until the window resets — `Retry-After` carries the cooldown in seconds and `X-RateLimit-Reset` the absolute reset time.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window (0 on a 429).

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix epoch seconds at which the current window resets.

BadGateway.description: An upstream dependency returned an invalid response.

PermanentRedirect.description: Permanent Redirect (RFC 7538). This URL is deprecated; follow `Location` to the canonical `/v1/<resource>/<scope>/<scope_id>` shape. Method and body are preserved across the redirect — modern clients re-issue the same `PUT` / `POST` / `DELETE` against the target unchanged.

Location.description: Canonical URL to follow. Preserves the original query string.

Deprecation.description: RFC 8594 — `true` for every legacy alignment / protection URL.

Sunset.description: RFC 8594 — HTTP-date after which the legacy URL stops redirecting and returns 410 Gone. Currently `Fri, 15 Jan 2027 00:00:00 GMT`, aligned with the cards-as-primitive Phase 5 GA window.

Link.description: RFC 8288 — points to the deprecation guide (`rel="deprecation"`). Currently `<https://docs.mnemom.ai/concepts/cards-as-resources>; rel="deprecation"; type="text/html"`.

ServiceUnavailable.description: An upstream dependency is currently unavailable. The request was not processed; retry after the cooldown window.

PreconditionFailed.description: The `If-Match` header carried a stale ETag (the spec was updated since the caller read it). Run `GET` to fetch the current ETag, splice your changes onto the latest state, and retry the write. Cards-as-primitive Phase 4 W3.1.

PreconditionRequired.description: The `If-Match` header is missing on a sub-resource write. Sub-resource verbs use optimistic concurrency — read the current ETag via `GET`, then retry with `If-Match: "sha256:..."`. Cards-as-primitive Phase 4 W3.1.

RequestEntityTooLarge.description: Request body exceeded the per-endpoint size cap. Cards-as-primitive sub-resource verbs cap each primitive body at 64 KiB; full-card PUTs cap at 128 KiB (alignment) / 64 KiB (protection).

Agent.description: An agent. GET /v1/agents/{id} returns one of TWO projections by authorization: an ORGANIZATION-MEMBER (owner) caller receives the full agent row (all fields below); a NON-OWNER receives a reduced public projection (id, name, claimed, created_at, last_seen, status, avatar_url). additionalProperties is left open because the owner row is the full DB row and grows as agent-settings columns are added (ADR-053 / proof / DDR); over-constraining it would 500 the endpoint on the next migration under /v1 response enforcement.

claimed.description: Public projection only: whether the agent has been claimed by a user.

claimed_by.description: Owner projection: user id that claimed the agent.

created_by.description: Owner projection: user id that created the agent (provenance).

org_id.description: Owner projection: the agent's org binding (ADR-062 authz boundary).

agent_proof_hash.description: Owner projection: captured hash_proof of the bound key (mig 263).

deleted_at.description: Owner projection: soft-delete timestamp (null when live).

agent_hash.description: First 16 hex chars of `SHA256(apiKey + '|' + agentName)` for named agents, or `SHA256(apiKey)` for unnamed singleton agents. The gateway computes the same value on each request and uses it as the lookup key. See [Agent Identity](https://docs.mnemom.ai/concepts/agent-identity#agent_hash--the-canonical-identity-hash).

name.description: Agent name (2-32 chars, alphanumeric + hyphens). Present on all list and get responses.

key_prefix.description: First 8 chars of the bound API key hash — useful for key-rotation debugging.

caller.description: Self-describing caller context for THIS response. `org_member` callers receive the full owner record (all fields here); `anonymous`/`authenticated` (non-member) callers receive the reduced public projection (id, name, claimed, created_at, last_seen, status, avatar_url, caller). The differing field set is GOVERNED by this value — read it instead of inferring why a field is absent.

public.description: Identity-record visibility axis — whether the agent's IDENTITY RECORD is publicly discoverable. This is DISTINCT from reputation visibility: every registered agent's reputation is public by accountability standard (see `ReputationScore.visibility`). `public` here governs only the identity record, never the Trust Rating.

groups.description: Active groups this agent belongs to, name-ordered; `[]` when none. Present on org-fleet rows (GET /v1/orgs/{org_id}/agents). Archived groups are excluded.

AgentExemption.description: A single exemption row relaxing an org-template floor for one agent (ADR-008).

status.description: Always `active` today (forward-compat stub for future dual-control approval workflow).

AgentSettings.description: Per-agent operational observer-rollout flags. MNE-556 P4: the former behavioral toggles (aap_enabled, aip_enabled, proof_enabled, proof_rate, nudge_strategy, ddr_mode, analyze_output) were removed — that config now lives on the composed alignment card (PUT /agents/{id}/alignment-card). Only the observer V2/V1 rollout flags remain here.

observer_v2_primary_enabled.description: Whether the V2 observer retune is authoritative for this agent (default true).

observer_v1_shadow_enabled.description: Whether the V1 observer runs in parallel shadow for this agent (default false).

card_json.description: Full alignment card JSON per AAP spec

AlignmentCardSourcesEnvelope.description: Four-scope sources envelope returned by `GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/alignment-card?include=sources`. Per ADR-053 the envelope mirrors the composer cascade Platform → Org → Team(s) → Agent and carries the caller's effective role + a staleness signal.

teams.description: Zero-or-more team-scope contributions. Empty when the agent is in no teams (Charter §I11 amended). Ordered by `teams.created_at ASC` to match the composer's stable order.

composed_stale.description: True when `composed.card_json._composition.scopes_applied` disagrees with the current `team_templates` set in `gather_composition_inputs` (the queue worker will reconverge via the existing `needs_recompose` flag).

key.description: Full secret key, only returned on creation

scopes.description: Capabilities granted to this key. Default for new keys is `["gateway", "api:read", "api:write"]`. Admin scopes (`admin:org`, `admin:platform`) are opt-in and gated by the requester's role at mint time. See [API Keys → Scope vocabulary](https://docs.mnemom.ai/guides/api-keys#scope-vocabulary).

ApiKeyScope.description: Capability-based scope (ADR-049). `gateway` permits gateway-worker traffic; `api:read` and `api:write` permit identity-scoped GET and write endpoints respectively; `admin:org` permits org-admin operations on orgs the bearer owns/admins (per-request membership re-check); `admin:platform` permits `/v1/admin/*` Mnemom-staff operations (per-request staff-role re-check). The legacy `api` scope is accepted for backward compatibility and aliased to `api:read` + `api:write` at the auth gate; new keys should use the canonical vocabulary.

ApiKeyWhoAmI.description: Caller introspection — the principal authenticated for this request. Returned by `GET /v1/api-keys/whoami`. The handler is generalized across `cookie`, `jwt`, and `api_key` auth methods, so the API-key-specific fields (`key_id`, `account_id`, `scopes`) are null on cookie/JWT principals.

user_id.description: Authenticated principal identifier (Supabase user UUID for cookie/JWT auth; api-key-bound user UUID for api_key auth).

key_id.description: API key id (e.g. `mnk_...`), or null for cookie/JWT auth.

account_id.description: Billing account id, or null for cookie/JWT auth.

scopes.description: Capability scopes (ADR-049) for api-key auth; null for cookie/JWT. e.g., ['gateway.send', 'gateway.observe'].

BudgetAlertThreshold.description: One severity-tiered low-balance / budget-alert threshold (D5 alert hardening). A threshold fires when the account's overage cost (`currentCostCents`) reaches or exceeds `value_cents`. On write (`PUT /v1/billing/budget-alert`), callers may supply `value` in either `cents` (default) or `mu` (µ) via `unit`; 1 µ = 1¢ so the server normalizes both to the same `value_cents` integer stored here.

level.description: Severity level. Must rise monotonically with `value_cents` across a configured set.

value_cents.description: Normalized threshold value in integer cents.

message.description: Optional operator-authored message (e.g. an explicit "you are about to lose Mnemom protection features" notice).

CapabilityMapping.description: Policy-engine-internal capability mapping (the compiled form). The alignment card's own shape is CardCapability, which spells the action list `required_actions`; the engine renames it to `card_actions` when compiling.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this capability represents

tools.description: List of tool identifiers that belong to this capability

card_actions.description: Alignment card action types associated with this capability

CardCapability.description: One entry of an alignment card's `capabilities` map: a named capability binding tools to the bounded actions it grants. NOTE the action list is `required_actions` here — `card_actions` (see CapabilityMapping) is the policy engine's INTERNAL name for the same list and is not accepted on the card; writing it is rejected with `unknown_field_rejected` (MNE-5801).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this capability represents

required_actions.description: Entries of `autonomy.bounded_actions` this capability binds. A bounded action bound by no capability is reported as unmapped by the coverage check, and is denied outright when `enforcement.allow_unmapped_tools` is false.

allowed_domains.description: Domains this capability's tools may reach, when constrained

severity_on_unmapped.description: Severity to report when a tool in this capability is unmapped

CardSourceScope.description: One slice of a sources envelope. `card_json` carries the raw template at that scope (full UnifiedAlignment/Protection card, the org/team template, or the platform-defaults object). `available: false` means no card is configured at this scope.

ComposedAlignmentCard.description: OUTPUT-only variant of `UnifiedAlignmentCard` for the COMPOSED card the server emits on GET `/v1/alignment/{scope}/{id}`, `/effective`, and the `composed` field of preview-compose. Identical to `UnifiedAlignmentCard` except `principal` is optional (a default / org-scope composed card has no agent principal) and `values.declared` / `autonomy.bounded_actions` may be empty (a fresh card declares nothing yet). The strict `UnifiedAlignmentCard` remains the authoring/request contract.

card_version.description: Card schema version (required, non-empty). Current canonical value: `unified/2026-04-26`.

autonomy_mode.description: ADR-039 master switch for the action-policing pipeline (autonomy constraints). Required at the top level post-cutover; the legacy `enforcement.mode` location is rejected.

integrity_mode.description: ADR-039 master switch for the values/conscience pipeline (integrity constraints). Required at the top level post-cutover; the legacy `integrity.enforcement_mode` location is rejected.

card_id.description: Card row id. Server-assigned on PUT (`ac-{uuid}`).

agent_id.description: Target agent id. On PUT, server overwrites to match the URL path.

principal.description: Required object describing whose authority the agent acts under (ADR-039 Decision 10).

identifier.description: Required (non-empty) when principal.type is not `unspecified`; identifies the human / organization / agent.

declared.description: Ordered list of declared values. Phase 1 cards-as-primitive: each entry is either a catalog-v1 ID string (e.g. `'accuracy'`) or a parameterized map carrying optional `intensity` / `domain` / `severity_on_violation` / `scope` (e.g. `{id: 'accuracy', domain: 'financial', severity_on_violation: 'critical'}`).

enforcement.description: Optional ADR-039 Decision-3 user-facing knobs for unmapped-tool handling. The legacy `mode`, `unmapped_tool_action` and `fail_open` keys are REJECTED by the validator (mode → top-level autonomy_mode; fail_open → gateway env config).

allow_unmapped_tools.description: When true, tools not mapped to a capability are allowed by default.

default_unmapped_severity.description: Severity assigned to an unmapped tool when allow_unmapped_tools is false.

content_hash.description: Response-only: content hash of the composed card (`sha256:<hex>`), injected by the GET/PUT response. Server-assigned — do not send on a PUT.

version.description: Response-only: monotonic card version, injected by the GET/PUT response. Server-assigned — do not send on a PUT.

CompositionMetadata.description: System-managed block describing which scope sources merged into the canonical card. Only returned when `?include_composition=true`.

ConscienceValueOutput.description: OUTPUT variant of `ConscienceValue`. A conscience value read back from an agent's card (or the built-in DEFAULT_CONSCIENCE_VALUES) is `{type, content}` plus an optional stable `id` / `severity`; it has no `name` (only the `/conscience-values` PUT input attaches a name). `name` is therefore optional on output, and `id` / `severity` are documented.

DeletionRequestStatus.description: Tracks progress of the async GDPR Art. 17 deletion cascade (ADR-021).

DisagreementReview.description: Row from `disagreement_reviews` — a human-adjudicable action that failed to find consensus during enforcement.

action.description: Action the reviewer proposes to add to `autonomy_envelope.bounded_actions`.

Error.description: Canonical error envelope (ADR-API-001 conv 1). `error` is always an object — never a bare string. Every 4xx/5xx response across the API conforms to this shape; the runtime helper is `src/http-errors.ts::buildErrorBody`.

code.description:
Stable, machine-matchable failure identifier (lowercase snake_case). Clients may branch on this; the string is part of the contract.

**Status-class defaults** — emitted when no caller code is supplied (`errorCodeForStatus(status)`): `bad_request` (400), `unauthorized` (401), `forbidden` (403), `not_found` (404), `method_not_allowed` (405), `conflict` (409), `gone` (410), `precondition_failed` (412), `payload_too_large` (413), `unsupported_media_type` (415), `unprocessable_entity` (422), `precondition_required` (428), `rate_limited` (429), `internal_error` (500), `not_implemented` (501), `bad_gateway` (502), `service_unavailable` (503), `gateway_timeout` (504). Fallback `error` for unmapped statuses.

**Caller-supplied codes** — handlers may pass an explicit `code` for a specific failure class. Examples: `agent_not_found`, `invalid_hash_proof`, `already_linked`, `idempotency_conflict`, `feature_gated`, `schema_validation_failed`, `no_token`, `bad_canonical_payload`.

**Care-framed sub-resource codes** — the cards-as-primitive surface passes its stable care code-string straight through as `error.code`. Examples: `if_match_absent`, `if_match_stale`, `if_match_malformed`, `primitive_validation_failed`.

message.description: Human-readable, care-framed explanation of the failure.

details.description: Optional structured context for the failure (any JSON value: object, array, or primitive). Common shapes: validation findings list, idempotency-conflict diff, `{presented_etag, current_etag}` on a stale `If-Match`, etc. Mirrors the helper's `details?: unknown`.

EscalationTrigger.description: Defines a condition that triggers an escalation action.

condition.description: Expression or rule describing when this trigger fires (e.g. 'violation_count > 3')

action.description: Action to take when the condition is met

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this escalation exists

FaultLine.description: A single fault line identified in team alignment analysis.

id.description: Unique identifier for this fault line

value.description: The specific value, capability, or constraint that constitutes the fault line

classification.description: Classification of the fault line's nature

agents_declaring.description: Agent IDs that declare or satisfy this requirement

agents_missing.description: Agent IDs that are missing this requirement

agents_conflicting.description: Agent IDs whose declared conflicts_with includes this value

impact_score.description: Estimated impact of this fault line on team alignment (0.0 to 1.0)

resolution_hint.description: Suggested action to resolve this fault line

affects_capabilities.description: Bounded actions/capabilities shared by all involved agents

FaultLineAnalysis.description: Complete fault line analysis result for a team.

analysis_id.description: Unique identifier for this analysis run

fault_lines.description: Identified fault lines sorted by severity then impact_score desc

alignments.description: Detected alignment patterns — sets of agents consistently isolated across multiple fault lines.

coherence.description: @mnemom/team-coherence v2 dimensional coherence vector (governance median, conflict edges, conscience/integrity invariants + narrative helpers). Replaces the deprecated scalar fleet_score.

FaultLineSummary.description: Aggregated fault-line counts by classification (AAP `FaultLineSummary`). All counts are non-negative integers; every field is present even when no fault lines were detected (all zero).

ForbiddenRule.description: A rule that forbids tools matching a specific pattern.

pattern.description: Glob or regex pattern matching tool identifiers to forbid

reason.description: Human-readable reason why these tools are forbidden

severity.description: Severity level when a forbidden tool is invoked

GovernanceCoverageReport.description: Coverage rollup across the org's teams.

GovernanceNotificationState.description: Per-channel dispatch state populated by the notification dispatcher.

GovernanceSignal.description: A governance signal row — operator-actionable observation per ADR-048.

GovernanceSignalScope.description: Scope at which the signal is produced and routed (ADR-048 §1).

GovernanceSignalSource.description: Source detector for the signal. Closed enum per ADR-048 §1. `network.threat_level.changed` added in migration 234.

InclusionProofResponse.description: Merkle inclusion proof for a checkpoint

leaf_hash.description: SHA-256 leaf hash of this checkpoint

leaf_index.description: Index of this leaf in the tree

siblings.description: O(log N) sibling hashes for proof verification

position.description: Position of sibling relative to the path node

tree_size.description: Total number of leaves in the tree

verified.description: Whether the proof was verified against the stored root

IntegrityCertificate.description: Machine-readable cryptographic certificate for an integrity checkpoint. Modeled on C2PA content credentials and W3C Verifiable Credentials.

subject.description: Identifies the checkpoint this certificate attests to

thinking_block_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the thinking block

card_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the Alignment Card

combined_commitment.description: SHA-256 of all input fields concatenated

signed_payload.description: Deterministic JSON string that was signed

merkle.description: Merkle inclusion proof. Null if not yet added to tree.

verdict_derivation.description: SP1 STARK proof. Null if not yet proven.

integrity_score.description: MNE-7126: violation-free rate among CHECKPOINTED traces = verified_traces / (verified_traces + violation_count). Value between 0 and 1; 1.0 when there are no violations, regardless of how many traces were checkpointed. This is INTEGRITY (did checkpointed traces pass?), NOT verification coverage — see verification_coverage.

verification_coverage.description: MNE-7126: fraction of ALL traces that received a verification verdict = (verified_traces + violation_count) / total_traces. Value between 0 and 1; 0 when there are no traces. This is COVERAGE (how much of the agent's activity was checkpointed?), a signal DISTINCT from integrity_score — a low value means un-checkpointed / observe-mode traces, never a violation.

bounded_refusal_count.description: MNE-596: count of traces AAP structurally flagged but reclassified as a correctly policy-refused attack (AIP independently confirmed clear; no bounded action was ever executed). Logged for transparency — already counted toward verified_traces and excluded from violation_count, so it does not reduce integrity_score.

MerkleRootResponse.description: Current Merkle tree root and metadata for an agent

leaf_count.description: Total number of checkpoint leaves in the tree

last_updated.description: When the tree was last updated

MyRole.description: The caller's effective role on the resource. Computed server-side per ADR-053; frontends derive `canEdit` exclusively from this field. `team_admin` only appears on team-scope responses. `null` means the caller has no role on this resource (the request still authenticated, but no role applies — e.g. an org-scope response read by an unrelated user).

NetworkThreatBucket.description: One per-axis bucket in the Protection Network L4 thermometer. The `bucket_value` is the L0 fingerprint slice for the axis (substrate / vertical / pattern / source) and carries no per-tenant identifier — public-aggregate disclosure model per concept.md §"Cross-tenant disclosure."

bucket_value.description: L0 fingerprint slice (e.g. substrate / vertical / pattern / source identifier).

prior_state.description: Previous state if a transition has been observed; null until the bucket has changed state at least once.

state_changed_at.description: Wall-clock time of the most recent state transition.

updated_at.description: Wall-clock time the rolling-stats roll-up last touched this row.

OnChainAnchorResult.description: An on-chain Merkle-root anchoring record — a row from the `on_chain_anchors` table (migration 057). Returned by GET /on-chain/history (raw row, all columns) and embedded as `latest_anchor` in GET /on-chain/status (subset via the get_on_chain_status RPC, which omits gas_used/created_at).

merkle_root.description: Hex-encoded Merkle root hash that was anchored

tx_hash.description: Blockchain transaction hash. Null while the anchor is pending (recorded before the transaction is broadcast).

block_number.description: Block number in which the transaction was included. Null until the anchor is confirmed on-chain.

leaf_count.description: Number of leaves covered by this anchor.

gas_used.description: Gas consumed by the anchoring transaction. Null until the transaction is broadcast/confirmed.

chain.description: Blockchain network where the anchor was created. Matches the on_chain_anchors.chain CHECK constraint; defaults to `base-sepolia`.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the anchor record.

anchored_at.description: Timestamp when the anchor was created

created_at.description: Row creation timestamp (present on raw history rows).

OperatorAttestationRequest.description: Sign an operator-issued attestation about a checkpoint, signal, or audit-relevant event. Returns an Ed25519-signed envelope binding the operator's identity to the asserted statement at the asserted time.

billing_account_id.description: Stripe billing account. NULL for personal orgs (no billing account provisioned).

role.description: The caller's role in this org (membership-scoped listings only).

is_owner.description: Whether the caller owns this org (membership-scoped listings only).

is_personal.description: Whether this is the caller's auto-provisioned personal org.

accepted_at.description: When the caller accepted membership (membership-scoped listings only).

OrgCardTemplate.description: Organization alignment card template that all agents inherit

template.description: The alignment card template JSON

created_by.description: User ID who created the template

updated_by.description: User ID who last updated the template

OrgConscienceAuditEntry.description: Audit log entry for conscience value changes

OrgConscienceValue.description: A custom conscience value for an organization

OrgTemplateSourcesEnvelope.description: Two-scope sources envelope returned by `GET /v1/orgs/{org_id}/{alignment,protection}-template?include=sources`. No team or agent layer (org templates compose only against the platform floor).

PaymentMethod.description: One saved payment instrument, as a TOKENIZED representation. `last4` is the maximum instrument detail this API will ever return: there is no field here for a full card number, a full bank account number, or a CVC, and none may be added — the handler builds this object field-by-field precisely so a new Stripe field cannot leak through by passthrough.

kind.description: Instrument kind — `card`, `us_bank_account`, `sepa_debit`, `link`, … Unrecognized kinds are passed through verbatim rather than dropped, so a newly-supported instrument still renders as *something* rather than disappearing.

brand.description: Card network (`visa`, `mastercard`, `amex`, …) or, for a bank account, the bank name.

last4.description: Last four digits only — never more.

expMonth.description: Card expiry month. Absent for non-card instruments.

expYear.description: Card expiry year. Absent for non-card instruments.

bankAccountStatus.description: Present and equal to `blocked` when a bank-account instrument has been blocked by the bank or network and can no longer be charged. Absent for cards, and absent for a bank account with nothing reported — absent does NOT mean 'verified'. (The payment provider exposes no micro-deposit verification state on a saved instrument, so none is claimed here.)

isDefault.description: Whether future invoices are charged to this instrument.

PaymentMethodList.description: The organization's saved instruments. An empty array means genuinely nothing on file — a failure is a 4xx/5xx, never an empty list, so an outage can never read as 'you have no payment method'.

release_ring.description: Release ring controlling feature exposure (MNE-889). Carried in feature_flags alongside the boolean gates; defaults to `ga`.

PlatformCardDefaultsResponse.description: Base (non-`?include=sources`) JSON body of `GET /v1/{alignment,protection}/platform/{scope_id}`. The platform scope is a template/defaults wrapper, not a full composed card: `handleGet` in src/composition/platform-handlers.ts returns `{ defaults, available }` where `defaults` is the authored platform-defaults JSON (a partial card) or `null` when none is set. YAML is the default representation and is not response-validated; this schema governs the JSON variant returned on `Accept: application/json`.

defaults.description: The authored platform-scope defaults JSON (a partial card), or `null` when no platform defaults are set.

available.description: True when platform-scope defaults are set (`defaults !== null`).

PlatformCardSourceScope.description: One scope leaf in the platform two-scope sources envelope. `card_json` is the platform-defaults JSON (a partial card) or `null`.

PlatformCardSourcesEnvelope.description: Two-scope sources envelope returned by `GET /v1/{alignment,protection}/platform/{scope_id}?include=sources` (JSON-only). Composed equals Platform — the platform scope is the top of the cascade, so there is no upstream layer to constrain it. Shape matches the `?include=sources` branch of `handleGet` in src/composition/platform-handlers.ts.

Policy.description: A complete CLPI policy document defining capability mappings, forbidden tools, escalation triggers, and enforcement defaults.

capability_mappings.description: Map of capability names to their definitions

PolicyDefaults.description: Default enforcement behavior for tools and situations not explicitly covered by the policy.

unmapped_tool_action.description: Action to take when a tool is not mapped to any capability

unmapped_severity.description: Severity level assigned to unmapped tool invocations

fail_open.description: If true, allow actions when the policy engine is unavailable. If false, block by default.

enforcement_mode.description: Default enforcement mode for the policy

grace_period_hours.description: Number of hours to allow violations before enforcement kicks in (for new policy rollouts)

PolicyEvaluationResult.description: Result of evaluating a CLPI policy against a set of tools or traces.

card_gaps.description: Gaps between the policy and the alignment card

coverage.description: Fraction of tools covered by the policy (0.0 to 1.0)

PolicyMeta.description: Metadata for a CLPI policy including schema version, name, description, and scope.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the policy schema (e.g. '1.0.0')

name.description: Human-readable name of the policy

description.description: Detailed description of the policy's purpose

scope.description: Scope at which the policy applies

PolicyViolation.description: A single policy violation detected during evaluation.

tool.description: Tool identifier that triggered the violation

capability.description: Capability the tool was mapped to, if any

rule.description: The specific rule or pattern that was matched

Posture.description: Trust posture row (mig 173). Library row; revisions are versioned bodies stored separately.

current_revision_id.description: FK to trust_posture_revisions; NULL only mid-create.

assigned_revision_id.description: Revision pinned at assignment time (null = tracks current_revision_id).

replaced_prior.description: `true` when this assignment displaced a previously-active assignment on the team.

PostureBody.description: Trust posture body (PostureBody v1.0). Matches the runtime validator at src/composition/posture-validate.ts EXACTLY — strict-unknown-field rejection (additionalProperties:false) at every level, so adding a field requires a posture_schema_version bump (ADR-023/ADR-045). Used as the `body` of POST /v1/postures and PUT /v1/postures/{id}.

posture_schema_version.description: Schema version pin. Must be exactly `v1.0`.

pairwise_governance_floor_below.description: Fire when pairwise governance floor drops below this; null disables.

conflict_edge_count_exceeds.description: Fire when conflict-edge count exceeds this; null disables.

outlier_agents_count_exceeds.description: Fire when outlier-agent count exceeds this; null disables.

min_pair_score_below.description: Flag pairs scoring below this; null disables.

PostureComposePreview.description: Dry-run composition a posture would produce for a team (POST /v1/postures/{id}/preview-compose). Matches handlePreviewComposePosture exactly: the editor-shaped composed view plus the org floor (Platform ⊕ Org, no team layer). team_id/org_id are null for an org-scoped preview with no resolved team.

composed.description: Composed posture with the path posture substituted as the team layer.

floor.description: Org floor (Platform ⊕ Org-default, no team layer) for the editor's 3-column view.

PostureDiff.description: Structural diff between two revisions (GET /v1/postures/{id}/diff). Matches handleDiffPostureRevisions exactly.

path.description: Dot-path to the changed leaf (`$` for a root scalar change).

PostureEffects.description: Analytics rollup: cells affected by this posture revision over a window.

PostureRevision.description: Versioned posture body. Immutable by handler discipline (forward-only). Matches revisionForResponse() exactly.

body.description: The versioned posture body (PostureBody shape; older revisions may predate the v1.0 schema).

ProductInvite.description: An RG product invite (MNE-7091). Note: the admin-only `initial_grant_amount_mu` is intentionally absent — it is persisted server-side but never returned in any response.

account_id.description: The target account. Null for an email-bound invite minted for a not-yet-existing user (migration 501) — `invite_email` names the target instead, and `account_id` is backfilled on accept.

invite_email.description: Set (lowercased) instead of `account_id` when this invite was minted for a brand-new email with no account yet (migration 501). Null for every account_id-bound invite.

message_body.description: The per-invite message snapshot — the exact copy this invite's email renders (MNE-7117). Distinct from `message_template_id`, which records only which saved template the admin started from. Null when the admin sent no custom body (the email then falls back to the template body, else the built-in default). Unlike the grant amount this IS invitee-facing copy, so it is returned rather than stripped.

accept_link.description: The invitee-facing URL to accept the invite.

ProofStatusResponse.description: ZK proof status and metadata for a checkpoint

checkpoint_id.description: The checkpoint this proof is for

image_id.description: Guest program image ID (set when proving begins)

proving_duration_ms.description: Wall-clock proving time in milliseconds (set when completed)

verified.description: Whether the proof has been verified

verified_at.description: When the proof was verified (null if not yet verified)

created_at.description: When the proof request was created

updated_at.description: When the proof record was last updated

ProtectionCardSourcesEnvelope.description: Four-scope sources envelope returned by `GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/protection-card?include=sources`. Identical shape to `AlignmentCardSourcesEnvelope`.

PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON.description: WebAuthn registration options (base64url-encoded per the WebAuthn Level 3 JSON serialization).

QuarantineItem.description: Quarantined message row. Stores only `content_hash` — the original plaintext is not retained once the message is quarantined.

Receipt.description: A completed prepay μ purchase. The instrument summary is redacted by design — kind, brand, last four and expiry only; a full instrument number never crosses this boundary.

mmu.description: μ credited in mmu at the face peg (1 cent = 1000 mmu). Null for a non-usd charge, which has no defined face value here.

mu.description: The same credited amount expressed in native μ as a decimal string (1μ = 1000 mmu), emitted alongside `mmu` (MNE-6767, μ-native migration). Null whenever `mmu` is null.

ReclassificationRequest.description: Request to reclassify a checkpoint violation.

checkpoint_id.description: Identifier of the checkpoint to reclassify

card_amendment_id.description: Optional ID of an alignment card amendment that triggered this reclassification

after_classification.description: Verdict the checkpoint is reclassified TO (MNE-2156). Omit for a full exoneration ('clear', the historical behavior); send 'review_needed' or 'boundary_violation' when the review lowers the severity without clearing the agent. An unrecognized value is rejected with 400 — it is never coerced to 'clear'. This is deliberately a SUBSET of the checkpoint verdict enum: 'unverified' means the integrity control did not run, which the system assigns and a reviewer cannot choose.

ReclassificationResult.description: Result of a checkpoint violation reclassification.

score_impact.description: Impact of the reclassification on the agent's score

RegistrationResponseJSON.description: Browser's `navigator.credentials.create()` response, JSON-serialized per the WebAuthn Level 3 JSON form.

ReputationScore.description: Agent reputation row computed by the reputation worker's 6-hour cron. Grade alphabet: `AAA AA+ AA A+ A B+ B C+ C D NR` (NR = not-rated, insufficient data). Score is an integer 0–1000.

checkpoint_accounting.description: Structured breakdown of how checkpoints were counted toward the score. `analyzed` is the scoring population; `excluded` buckets are mutually exclusive and `analyzed + synthetic + insufficient_thinking + quarantined = total`. Null for legacy rows computed before this field existed.

total.description: All checkpoints recorded for the agent.

analyzed.description: Checkpoints that counted toward the score (drives the X/50 eligibility gauge).

insufficient_thinking.description: Zero-analysis checkpoints (no extraction confidence, thinking tokens, or analysis duration).

quarantined.description: Checkpoints referenced by a non-expired enforce advisory; excluded from scoring entirely.

re_evaluated.description: How many of the agent's checkpoints carry each kind of re-evaluation annotation (counted over `total`, not the analyzed subset). Observability only — these are not an exclusion bucket and do not enter the score arithmetic. Absent on scores computed before this breakdown existed.

corrected_non_clear.description: Checkpoints corrected to a NON-clear verdict — a cross-turn escalation or a reviewer reclassification to `review_needed`/`boundary_violation`. These count against the score per the correction, not as exonerations; a non-zero value is why this agent's score differs from the pre-MNE-2156 calculation.

resolved_no_correction.description: Checkpoints re-evaluated with NO recorded correction — the trust-recovery convention, scored as `clear`.

next_compute_at.description: Next scheduled recompute — the 00/06/12/18 UTC cron slot strictly after `computed_at` (`floor(computed_at/6h)*6h + 6h`). Null when `computed_at` is null.

visibility.description: Reputation-publication axis — whether this agent's Trust Rating is published. Every registered agent's reputation is `public` by accountability standard (the default; that is the whole point of a portable, verifiable rating); `private` is a rare owner opt-out that 403s the read to non-owners. This is DISTINCT from `Agent.public` (the identity-record visibility axis) — they share the word "public" but govern different things.

a2a_trust_extension.description: A2A trust extension for interop. Only present on `GET /reputation/{agent_id}` (not on batch/compare rows).

RetentionSettings.description: Aletheia Customer Voice retention configuration for an org (MNE-2407, `feedback_retention_settings`). `retention_days` is a caller-configured retention window (1-3650) or `null` to retain indefinitely (the default for an org with no configured row yet). `enforcement_active` is ALWAYS `false` today — this build ships configuration + storage + audit only; no cron yet reads `retention_days` to auto-erase aged submissions (tracked follow-up, MNE-440/MNE-443). Returned by both `GET` and `PATCH .../customer-voice/settings`.

retention_days.description: Retention window in days, or `null` to retain indefinitely.

updated_by.description: User id that last wrote this setting, or `null` if never set.

updated_at.description: When this setting was last written, or `null` if never set.

enforcement_active.description: Always `false` today (honest-voice, MNE-440/MNE-443): retention configuration is stored and audited but not yet enforced by any deletion cron.

ReviewLifecycle.description: A Safe House review-hold lifecycle row, as read by `GET /v1/safe-house/reviews[/{review_id}]` (Task A1/A2, canonical-consumer plan). This is the reconcile/backfill ("pull, truth") leg of the review-hold lifecycle — the same shape delivered live via the `sh.review.*` webhook ("push, latency"). Reflects the already-attested `screen.review` jsonb off `safe_house_decisions`; this API never writes to that table.

verdict.description: The reconciled verdict on the ruling `safe_house_decisions` row.

reviewer_model.description: Pinned reviewer model, e.g. `claude-opus-4-8`, when the review was adjudicated.

RiskAssessment.description: Individual risk assessment row (`ra-…`). Produced by `POST /risk/assess`.

RiskForecast.description: Risk forecast for a team based on alignment trends and fault lines.

mode.description: Description of the potential failure mode

impact.description: Estimated impact if the failure occurs

failure_modes.description: Ranked list of potential failure modes

overall_risk_level.description: Overall risk level for the team

confidence.description: Confidence level of the forecast (0.0 to 1.0)

SafeHouseCanary.description: Canary credential planted in an agent context. `canary_value` is only returned on creation.

SafeHouseEvaluation.description: Row from `sh_evaluations` — one screening decision (inbound or outbound). `threats` and `detector_scores` depend on detector config.

SafeHousePattern.description: Row from `sh_threat_patterns`. `label: "benign"` patterns are used to suppress false positives; `label: "malicious"` patterns add to L1/L2 detection.

SelfHostedDeployment.description: A self-hosted Mnemom deployment registered by an org.

SidebandAdvisoryRow.description: Legacy pre-cutover sideband row. Post ADR-048 cutover, sideband.* sources are written to governance_signals; this query endpoint surveys what historical rows remain in pending_advisories. Sunsetting; clients should consume governance_signals directly.

SidebandCoverageReport.description: Per-team sideband sweep coverage over a 30-day window: per-axis rollup + raw daily rows. Operator dashboard input.

team_id.description: Team the coverage was computed for.

window_days.description: Lookback window in days over which coverage is aggregated (currently fixed at 30).

summary.description: Per-axis rollup of sweep counts over the window.

last_swept_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent sweep for this axis, or null if never swept in-window.

last_outcome.description: Outcome recorded on the most recent sweep, or null.

rows.description: Raw per-day, per-axis sweep log rows, ordered day desc then axis asc.

SigningKeyInfo.description: Ed25519 signing key metadata. Public keys are used to verify IntegrityCertificate signatures.

is_active.description: Whether the key is currently in use for new signatures

name.description: Display name

TeamAdmin.description: Team-admin grant — allows a non-org-admin user to administer one team.

revoked_at.description: When the grant was revoked. `null` on active grants.

idempotent_noop.description: Present on grant and revoke responses. `true` when the request was a no-op (grant already active / already revoked).

TeamEffectivePosture.description: The team's actual posture cascade (GET /v1/teams/{id}/effective-posture). Matches handleGetTeamEffectivePosture exactly: the gathered Platform → Org → Team layers (each null when its cascade source is unset) plus the composed body.

platform_default.description: Platform-default posture layer, or null when unset.

org_assigned.description: Org-assigned posture layer, or null when unset.

team_assigned.description: Team-assigned posture layer, or null when unset.

composed.description: Composed posture (Platform ⊕ Org ⊕ Team cascade closure).

role.description: team_members.role — the agent's role inside the team (e.g. 'member', 'lead').

joined_at.description: Alias for added_at, returned by the list endpoint for UI convenience.

reputation_score.description: Agent's reputation score, joined from reputation_scores at list time. `null` when no row exists OR the agent's visibility is private.

reputation_grade.description: Agent's reputation grade (A+, A, B+, ..., NR). `null` under the same conditions as reputation_score.

is_eligible.description: Whether the agent has crossed the eligibility threshold. The UI honors this to avoid rendering a misleading grade circle for agents that haven't accumulated enough checkpoints.

TeamMyRoleResponse.description: Response body of `GET /v1/teams/{team_id}/my-role`. Used by surfaces that don't load a template sources envelope (team roster tab, identity card tab, admins tab) to gate edit affordances from the same single source of truth as the editors.

visibility.description: Reputation-publication axis for the team's Trust Rating: `public` (published by standard), `unlisted` (readable by id but hidden from the directory), or `private` (owner opt-out). Distinct from any identity-record visibility — shares the word "public" but governs only whether the rating is published.

TeamRiskAssessment.description: Team risk assessment row (`tra-…`). Produced by `POST /risk/assess/team`. Three-pillar result (portfolio + coherence + concentration) with weakest-link and Shapley attribution per member.

TeamTemplateSourcesEnvelope.description: Three-scope sources envelope returned by `GET /v1/teams/{team_id}/{alignment,protection}-template?include=sources`. The team row is the editable scope; agent layer is omitted (team-scope has no specific agent above it).

composed_stale.description: Always false at team-template scope today (team-scope composition is in-memory per request). Included for envelope symmetry with the agent-scope envelopes.

TrustEdge.description: Directed trust-relationship edge between two agents (CLPI Phase 3). Used by the trust-topology RPC and the team reputation scorer.

UnifiedAlignmentCard.description: Unified alignment card (ADR-008/ADR-039). Authored in YAML or JSON; composed server-side with platform defaults, org template, and active exemptions before storage. This schema matches the runtime validator at src/composition/validate.ts EXACTLY — a card authored strictly to it passes `PUT /v1/agents/{id}/alignment-card` and the preview-compose endpoint. Output-only fields (card_id, issued_at, expires_at, _composition, content_hash, version) are server-assigned and must NOT be sent on a PUT.

card_version.description: Card schema version (required, non-empty). Current canonical value: `unified/2026-04-26`.

autonomy_mode.description: ADR-039 master switch for the action-policing pipeline (autonomy constraints). Required at the top level post-cutover; the legacy `enforcement.mode` location is rejected.

integrity_mode.description: ADR-039 master switch for the values/conscience pipeline (integrity constraints). Required at the top level post-cutover; the legacy `integrity.enforcement_mode` location is rejected.

card_id.description: Card row id. Server-assigned on PUT (`ac-{uuid}`).

agent_id.description: Target agent id. On PUT, server overwrites to match the URL path.

principal.description: Required object describing whose authority the agent acts under (ADR-039 Decision 10).

identifier.description: Required (non-empty) when principal.type is not `unspecified`; identifies the human / organization / agent.

declared.description: Ordered list of declared values. Phase 1 cards-as-primitive: each entry is either a catalog-v1 ID string (e.g. `'accuracy'`) or a parameterized map carrying optional `intensity` / `domain` / `severity_on_violation` / `scope` (e.g. `{id: 'accuracy', domain: 'financial', severity_on_violation: 'critical'}`).

enforcement.description: Optional ADR-039 Decision-3 user-facing knobs for unmapped-tool handling. The legacy `mode`, `unmapped_tool_action` and `fail_open` keys are REJECTED by the validator (mode → top-level autonomy_mode; fail_open → gateway env config).

allow_unmapped_tools.description: When true, tools not mapped to a capability are allowed by default.

default_unmapped_severity.description: Severity assigned to an unmapped tool when allow_unmapped_tools is false.

content_hash.description: Response-only: content hash of the composed card (`sha256:<hex>`), injected by the GET/PUT response. Server-assigned — do not send on a PUT.

version.description: Response-only: monotonic card version, injected by the GET/PUT response. Server-assigned — do not send on a PUT.

UnifiedProtectionCard.description: Unified protection card (ADR-037). Safe House thresholds + trusted-source policy for a single agent. Shape matches src/composition/types.ts::UnifiedProtectionCard (canonical) and what the runtime validator at src/composition/validate.ts accepts. The customer-facing docs at /concepts/protection-card and /specifications/protection-card-schema document this same shape.

mode.description: Strictest-wins composition: enforce > nudge > observe > off.

thresholds.description: Score bands. Must satisfy warn <= quarantine <= block; each value in [0, 1].

screen_surfaces.description: Which request surfaces Safe House inspects. Composed across scopes by OR-per-field (any scope requiring inspection wins).

incoming.description: The user/principal prompt entering the agent.

outgoing.description: The agent's response leaving the agent.

tool_responses.description: Responses to tool calls returning to the agent.

trusted_sources.description: Sources for which detectors short-circuit (each match logged in the trace). Composed as platform->agent intersection (compliance ceiling) with org+agent union inside that ceiling — an agent cannot widen trust beyond what the platform allows.

protected_surface.description: Org-declared protected surface policy (MNE-830). Strengthen-only UNION across platform → org → team → agent: each scope may add entries; none may remove. The composer always emits this block; callers omit it to inherit the composed floor. See ADR-037 §protected_surface.

assets.description: Protected assets. Intrinsic identity = `${kind}:${selector}` (normalized). Composer merges by identity, keeping the strictest entry per scope.

source_scope.description: Composer-assigned provenance (`platform`, `org:<id>`, `team:<id>`, `agent:<id>`). Server-assigned — do not send on a PUT.

forbidden_operations.description: Operations that are unconditionally forbidden. Intrinsic identity = normalized `pattern`. Composer unions across scopes; on identity collision, severity → max.

applies_to.description: Asset identities (`${kind}:${selector}`) this operation applies to. Empty/absent means GLOBAL.

severity.description: Severity level. Composer merges to strictest across scopes.

source_scope.description: Composer-assigned provenance. Server-assigned — do not send on a PUT.

escalation_required.description: Operations that require escalation before proceeding. Same intrinsic-identity + union rules as forbidden_operations (minus severity).

applies_to.description: Asset identities this escalation applies to. Empty/absent = GLOBAL.

source_scope.description: Composer-assigned provenance. Server-assigned — do not send on a PUT.

review.description: Review-hold policy (Safe House Review, Slice 2a — MNE-920 design). gate_on is the minimum verdict band per surface that escalates to a review-hold. Composition is strictest-wins; on_timeout defaults to 'reject' (fail-closed). reviewer.kind 'endpoint' is designed for MNE-1650 and not consumed yet.

get.summary: Live goal state of one Mnemom Agent session
get.description: Backs `mnemom agent show`. Resolves the org like `GET /v1/code/entitlement` (explicit `org_id` else the caller's primary org), requires membership, and confirms `agent_id` belongs to that org — an unknown agent and an agent in another org are the SAME 404 `agent_not_found`, so existence never leaks across tenants. Then relays the gateway's state for `conversationId` verbatim: the sealed goal contract (`sealed`, with the gateway's `hash` — the only sealed hash; a locally computed one differs because the gateway normalises absent arrays), the latest alignment verdict, the turn counter and the guardrail ceilings/state. `null` sections mean the gateway holds nothing for that conversation (absence is data, never a 404). 503 `gateway_unavailable` when the gateway is unset or unreachable.

parameters.name: conversationId
parameters.description: The conversation id the CLI launched the session with.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The agent record id (`agents.id`) the session ran as.

parameters.name: org_id
parameters.description: Target organization (defaults to the caller's primary org).

200.description: The session's live goal state. Every gateway-owned section is nullable — a session that never sealed a goal contract returns `sealed: null`, `verdict: null`, `turn: null`, `guardrails: null`.

sealed.description: What the gateway sealed for this conversation.

contract.description: The sealed goal contract (statement, requirements, allowed/forbidden paths, ceilings) exactly as the gateway normalised it.

hash.description: The gateway's sealed hash — the canonical one.

turn.description: Turns the gateway has counted for this conversation.

ceilings.description: The guardrail ceilings the contract sealed.

state.description: Current guardrail counters (turns, spend, stall, crossed flags).

404.description: No org for the caller (`not_found`), or the agent does not exist / is not in the resolved org (`agent_not_found` — deliberately the same answer for both).

503.description: The agent lookup failed (retryable), or the Mnemom gateway is unset or unreachable (`gateway_unavailable`, with `details.reason`).

put.summary: Apply an atomic add/remove membership batch
put.description: Apply a mixed set of add + remove operations across multiple agents and multiple groups in a single call, **all-or-nothing**. The whole batch executes inside one database transaction: if any id is invalid, inaccessible, or belongs to a foreign org, the entire batch is rejected and nothing is applied. Membership is a set — an add of an existing member and a remove of a non-member are idempotent no-ops (reported via the `*_noop_count` fields), so re-sending an identical batch changes nothing and returns 200. Duplicate operations within one request are deduped; the same (agent, group) pair appearing as both an add and a remove is contradictory and rejected. At most 50 operations per request.

org_id.description: Organization that owns the targeted groups and agents

ops.description: The add/remove operations to apply atomically

op.description: Whether to add the agent to, or remove it from, the group

200.description: Batch applied atomically. `added`/`removed` are the ids that actually CHANGED; the `*_noop_count` fields count operations that were already in the requested state; `ops_applied` (post-dedupe) may be less than `ops_received` (raw count) when duplicate operations were collapsed.

added.description: Agent ids that were newly added (real changes only)

removed.description: Agent ids that were actually removed (real changes only)

add_noop_count.description: Add ops whose agent was already a member (idempotent no-op)

remove_noop_count.description: Remove ops whose agent was already absent (idempotent no-op)

ops_received.description: Raw operation count as submitted (before dedupe)

400.description: Bad request. Covers a malformed body / missing `org_id` / non-array or empty `ops` / over-limit (`> 50`); an invalid op value, group_id, or agent_id; a contradictory add+remove of the same (agent, group) pair (`error.code: "conflicting_ops"`); an archived target group (`error.code: "group_archived"`); and an inaccessible/foreign-org **agent** id. Note: an inaccessible or foreign-org agent is returned as **400** with `error.code: "agent_not_found"` — deliberately NOT a 404 — so a caller cannot distinguish a genuinely missing agent from one that exists in an organization they cannot see (no cross-org existence leakage), matching the single-agent membership endpoints.

404.description: An inaccessible, invalid, or foreign-org **group** id (`error.code: "group_not_found"`) — the same signal a genuinely missing group returns, so group existence does not leak across org boundaries. The entire batch is rejected; nothing is applied.

get.summary: Graph of the caller's agents + trust edges
get.description: Returns a `{nodes, edges}` graph of every agent linked to the authenticated user, suitable for dashboard topology rendering. Available to every authenticated caller — the former `trust_topology` plan gate was retired in MNE-2567, because this returns the caller's own data and output completeness never varies by pricing tier. Falls back to `{nodes: [], edges: []}` if the backing RPC fails.

200.description: Agent details. Private agents return a limited response to non-owners.

delete.description:
Tombstone an agent and asynchronously cascade deletion across all agent-owned records (traces, integrity checkpoints, drift alerts, reclassifications, etc.) per ADR-021. The request returns `202 Accepted` immediately with a `deletion_request_id`; poll [GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/deletion-status](/api-reference/endpoint/get-agents-agent-id-deletion-status) or subscribe to the deletion webhook for cascade progress.

Idempotent: re-DELETE on a tombstoned agent returns the existing `deletion_request_id` with the current status.

202.description: Deletion accepted; cascade will run asynchronously

deletion_request_id.description: Stable identifier for this deletion request; pass to deletion-status to poll progress.

status.description: Initial state of a fresh delete is `tombstoned` (the synchronous part); the async cascade advances it through `phase_1_complete` … `phase_7_complete` → `kv_cleared` → `pseudonymized` → `complete` (or `failed`). An idempotent re-DELETE echoes the current status, so any of these may appear.

completed_at.description: Set once the async cascade finishes. `null` while in flight.

Unauthenticated; cacheable for 60 seconds; ETag = combined canonical content_hash. cards-as-primitive Phase 5 B2.

Auth is `authorizeAgentAccess` (owner-org only, no public/anonymous bypass) — NOT the trace-viewer's `checkAgentPrivacy` gate, since this drafts governance-card content rather than surfacing raw traces.

post.summary: Claim an agent into an organization
post.description: Binds an unclaimed (or legacy hash-claimed) agent to the authenticated caller and an organization. Requires authentication — the caller proves possession of the agent via `hash_proof`, and the agent's `org_id` is set to the resolved org (the authz + listing boundary, ADR-062). Supply `org_id` to claim into a specific org the caller is a member of (role floor: member); omit it to claim into the caller's personal org. Idempotent: re-claiming an agent the caller already owns returns 200 with the resolved org.

hash_proof.description: Agent possession proof — either the live birth token (`mnbt_…`) whose row pins this agent's hash, or the full 64-hex SHA-256 digest of `${apiKey}|${agentName}` (or `${apiKey}` for an unnamed singleton agent).

org_id.description: Optional. The organization to claim the agent into (e.g. `org-...` or `pers-...`). The caller must be a member of this org (role floor: member). If omitted, the agent is claimed into the caller's personal org.

200.description: Agent claimed into the resolved organization

org_id.description: The organization the agent was claimed into (echoes the resolved org — the supplied `org_id`, or the caller's personal org when omitted).

409.description: Agent already claimed by a different account (`agent_cross_tenant`). The proof is valid but the agent is owned by another principal — this is a resource-state conflict, not a permission failure. Aligns with the hijack-closure contract (#609 / MNE-395).

post.summary: Move an agent to another organization (admin-in-both)
post.description: Role-based agent relocation between organizations. The caller must be an owner/admin of BOTH the agent's current (source) org and the destination org — this is the role-based counterpart to re-claim, which relocates by proof of possession (`hash_proof`); move never needs the agent's key. Personal↔company moves are allowed under the same rule. Side effects mirror claim's org-reassignment: billing/quota recompute, canonical-card recomposition (the destination org's template can floor/cap composed values, so the agent's effective posture may change), and source-org team memberships are closed. Every move writes an `agent.org_moved` governance audit row. Mutations require an `Idempotency-Key` header. Moving to the agent's current org is an idempotent no-op (`moved: false`).

The subscription secret (`webhook_secret_hash`) is never returned. Bounded by a server-clamped `limit` (default 100, max 200). Object-level authz matches the POST/DELETE siblings (org-boundary). cards-as-primitive Phase 5 C1.

delete.description: Removes the subscription row. Idempotent — repeated calls return 404 after the first. cards-as-primitive Phase 5 C1.

post.summary: Mint a one-time protection-write capability (the CISO grant)
post.description: Issues a SINGLE-USE, short-lived (15-minute) capability authorizing ONE subsequent protection-card write for the caller + agent. The protection card is the 'locked door' surface, so its write is gated behind an explicit, operator-approved grant rather than a standing one (the alignment card, by contrast, is standing). The caller MUST be a human operator that org-co-manages the agent (ADR-062). A human is recognised by capability, not transport: session, JWT, API-key, and OAuth principals carrying the broad `api:write` user capability (an `mcp:write` grant, e.g. the CLI's `mnemom login`) may mint; an OAuth principal carrying only per-agent resource scopes (`agent:<id>:<action>`) is rejected — an agent can never mint its own protection grant. Idempotent: a re-mint within the window refreshes the single live grant. No token is returned — the capability is a server-side record keyed to the caller; the agent then publishes its protection card via its own connection and the server consumes the live grant on a successful write.

action.description: The action this one-time capability authorizes.

expires_at.description: When the grant lapses if unused (15 minutes from mint).

403.description: Forbidden — the caller is an agent principal (an OAuth token without the `api:write` user capability; `agent_principal_cannot_mint`), or is not a member of the org that governs the agent.
